snippet.title: One Piece World Seeker – PS4/XB1/PC – Introduction Movie
snippet.description:
Watch the amazing introduction movie of ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER  and get ready to enjoy thrilling adventures on Jail Island!

Preorder ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER to gain access to an exclusive mission that reveals the secrets of the mysterious monster-shaped rocks of the island, as well as two unique outfits, the Luffy military costume and the Luffy swimsuit costume. PlayStation®4 players will also receive an extra item – the ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER dynamic theme.

Pre-order it on http://bnent.eu/preorderONEPIECEWORLDSEEKER

ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER will be available on March 15th, 2019 for PlayStation®4, Xbox One and PC.

Continue the adventure on:
ONE PIECE Games Official Website: www.OnePiece-Game.com  
Official Facebook Page: http://www.facebook.com/onepiece.videogames
Official Twitter Account: https://twitter.com/onepiece_games #onepieceworldseeker #onepiece #bandainamco
